entregables.titulo: First website and trailer

The game is still a single page you play offline against bots.

entregables.titulo: Online multiplayer: server, lobby and match flow
entregables.incluye: The game goes online with an authoritative server: it runs the physics, the client interpolates between snapshots and a dropped connection gets 15 s to come back to the same pill (REJOIN). Rooms wait for a minimum of real players, filled with bots that leave as people join. Spectate after dying, a loading screen with the pill and the title, FINDING ROOM / ROOM FOUND / WAITING banners, a 5-4-3-2-1 countdown with its sound, GO! when the scene is drawn, spawn immunity, an online arcade with its countdown and restart, and every text of the game in English.
entregables.hechoCuando: Two people on different networks play the same room, and a dropped player rejoins with their pill.
entregables.verificacion: Played with friends through a tunnel and then on the VPS; network HUD (F4) shows ping, snapshots, jitter and FPS.

tweet.texto: PillWars is online. An authoritative server runs every match, you get 15 seconds to rejoin if your connection drops, and the lobby fills with bots until real players arrive. #gamedev #multiplayer #indiedev

entregables.titulo: Admin panel and stress tests
entregables.incluye: A private control panel behind an admin key with rate limiting: live rules per room (speed, food, viruses, bots, minimum players, cap of real players), stats, ranking, countries, connections and an admin log. From the spectator view you can ban, give God, add mass, restart or shut rooms. Stress tests launched from the panel (bots that move like players, respawn, real ping/pong), a flood/DDoS test, snapshot rate (40/20/13/10 Hz), server health, then a dashboard with charts, world map, per-process CPU and one page per host.
entregables.hechoCuando: Every room can be tuned live from /admin and a stress test shows how many players the server holds.
entregables.verificacion: Stress test with 600 bots: tick p50 0.2 ms, p95 1 ms on one process; 600 players comfortable on the VPS with two hosts.

tweet.texto: Behind every PillWars room: a live control panel and stress tests with hundreds of bots playing like humans. 600 players run smoothly on our server. #gamedev #devlog #multiplayer

entregables.titulo: Production server, security and privacy
entregables.incluye: Deployment on a VPS with Caddy (automatic HTTPS and wss), systemd and setup/update scripts behind pillwars.fun on Cloudflare. Privacy by design: anonymised IPs, logs deleted after 60 days, a privacy policy and a contact form. Security work along the way: cheat commands blocked online, temporary spectator tokens, rate limits, private folders and project files never served, a security audit (deposit replays, predictable tokens), Solana library served from our own domain, HSTS and window isolation, SEO and www redirect.
entregables.hechoCuando: pillwars.fun serves the game over HTTPS and the private folders answer 403.
entregables.verificacion: Checked the blocked paths (server/, deploy/, docs/, programs/...) and the privacy page in production.

tweet.texto: Boring but important: PillWars runs on its own server with HTTPS, anonymised IPs and logs that delete themselves after 60 days. We only keep what the game needs. #privacy #gamedev

entregables.titulo: Daily Quests and Global Elite ranking
entregables.incluye: Daily Quests counted by the server (players can't inject values): rotating missions from a pool of 48+ variations, the same for everybody each day, with a Telegram reward for completing 3 of 5, shown in the game menu and on the website. Global Elite: a live ranking on the web with country flags and pagination, managed from the panel. Bot names from a generator with more than a million combinations.
entregables.hechoCuando: The day's quests show in the menu and on the web, and completing them unlocks the reward.
entregables.verificacion: Quests only count online and against server-side values; ranking refreshes from /ranking.json.

tweet.texto: New in PillWars: Daily Quests. Five missions a day, the same for every player, checked by the server. Finish 3 and unlock the private Telegram. #gamedev #indiedev

entregables.titulo: Scaling: AOI, binary protocol and multi-process
entregables.incluye: Each player only receives what their camera can see (AOI, which also kills map hacks), a binary protocol and then delta compression: from 11.9 KB to 0.9 KB per snapshot, and −70% more per extra player. Logical sharding with a matchmaker that stacks players into the fullest layer, room simulations in worker threads, and finally a Director that handles money and matchmaking plus one Host process per core, routed by path behind Caddy.
entregables.hechoCuando: The VPS runs a Director and two Hosts in production and 600 players fit comfortably.
entregables.verificacion: Measured locally and on the VPS: AOI + binary −92% bytes; tick p95 per host 8–9 ms without AOI, ~30 ms with it.

tweet.texto: How PillWars fits 600 players on a small server: you only get what your camera sees, in binary, and only what changed. Snapshots went from 11.9 KB to 0.9 KB. #gamedev #netcode #multiplayer

entregables.titulo: $PILL wallet, deposits, paid rooms and price oracle
entregables.incluye: A $PILL test token on Solana devnet and wallet connection (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack) with a mandatory signature. Deposits verified on-chain into an in-game balance, signed withdrawals, paid rooms that charge the entry from that balance, and the prize economy: classic carry with an exit fee by kills and arcade pots split among the top. A daily testnet faucet, an ORACLE that locks each room's price while people play and later follows the real market price, rooms at 2/5/10/20 $, 15-minute classic matches and the ROOM INFO popup.
entregables.hechoCuando: You deposit, play a paid room and cash out the prize to your wallet on devnet.
entregables.verificacion: End-to-end test of a full paid match on the split server; withdrawals require the wallet signature and are protected against replays.

galeria.texto: Price, players and rules before you enter.

tweet.texto: In PillWars every kill pays. Paid rooms from $2 to $20, prices locked while the room is playing, and you cash out straight to your Solana wallet. Testing on devnet. #Solana #web3gaming #gamedev

entregables.titulo: On-chain treasury, custody, staking and daily rewards
entregables.incluye: Anchor programs on Solana: a custody contract for players' money and a separate staking contract, both deployed on devnet. A daily leaderboard per wallet chained by hashes, Merkle rewards and match receipts anchored on-chain, a proof of liabilities so the server can't lie about what it owes, and an independent auditor that checks all of it. The rake goes to stakers over a week, daily prize pots scale with how many people played, and anti-cluster filters stop groups of wallets from farming. Public treasury page and REWARDS / STAKING / RANKING panels.
entregables.hechoCuando: Custody and staking run on devnet and the auditor validates receipts and liabilities.
entregables.verificacion: 134 Node tests plus vectors shared with the Rust tests; exercises against a real chain; attacks on our own leaderboard.

galeria.texto: Where the money goes, drawn from the code.

tweet.texto: Players' money in PillWars lives in an on-chain custody contract, every match receipt is anchored on Solana and anyone can audit what the game owes. Don't trust, verify. #Solana #web3gaming

entregables.titulo: Pixel art UI: font, HUD, skills and end screens
entregables.incluye: The whole game moves to pixel art: our own pixel font, GO! and countdown with glow, eight pixel skill icons, the skill bar and skill picker, TOP MASS and KILLS panels, ROOM/MASS/ALIVE in neon, baked banners (PENTAKILL, ONE MORE KILL, ROOM FOUND...), GAME OVER, VICTORY, CASHOUT and MATCH ENDED screens with their own frames, and a red X to close. A style lab and a poster editor were used to tune every piece and then removed.
entregables.hechoCuando: Every screen of a match, from GO! to GAME OVER, is drawn in pixel art.
entregables.verificacion: Side-by-side comparison page CLASSIC vs PIXEL for the whole UI; every poster checked in the poster editor.

tweet.texto: PillWars went full pixel art: our own font, eight new skill icons, a new HUD and end screens with their own frames. Same game, way more personality. #pixelart #gamedev #indiedev

entregables.titulo: Mode selector, login and menu art
entregables.incluye: The ARCADE / CLASSIC selector split by a neon laser, with stone titles drawn by David, food and viruses floating in the background that dodge the buttons, and a login per mode with the big pill, the name field and PLAY. ROOM PRICES and DAILY QUESTS boards in a stone frame, an EDIT LAYOUT mode to place every piece (saved for everybody on the server), and a title font drawn by geometry. Animated astronauts and energy portals were tried along the way and left out.
entregables.hechoCuando: From the selector you enter a mode and reach PLAY with the final art.
entregables.verificacion: Checked with F5 (no flashes of the old background) and with the layout saved on the server.

galeria.texto: PILLWARS ARCADE login with the pill and PLAY.
The menu with ROOM PRICES and DAILY QUESTS.

entregables.incluye: The pill gets its pixel look: pre-rotated, with directional light and shading bands that scale with size (tunable from the panel). Skill effects in pixel art, visible online and offline: sprint bolts, the immune shield, the blue magnet field and +/− pops for mass.
entregables.hechoCuando: Every buff shows its effect on the pill, for you and for rivals.
entregables.verificacion: Checked online and offline at small and huge sizes.

entregables.hechoCuando: Connecting, depositing and choosing a colour all use the final art.

entregables.incluye: The landing in pixel style: the real game playing in the background with a pill on autopilot, PLAY NOW, the official contract address, a top bar that collapses into MENU when it doesn't fit, the trailer with live stats (players, market cap, volume, money earned), the battle modes, The Skill Arsenal with a video per skill, Daily Quests, Skin Store and a loading screen with sound. entregables.verificacion: Zoom and narrow windows checked; mobile without sideways scroll.

entregables.incluye: Pills dressed in their country's flag, with emblems drawn in layers. A Skin Store in the game and on the web: buy with SP (Skin Points from quests) or $PILL (burned on devnet), a CONVERT tab, YOUR SKINS to equip, and ownership kept by the server, not the browser.
entregables.hechoCuando: You buy a skin, equip it and play with it.
entregables.verificacion: Bought and equipped on devnet; the equipped pill survives F5 because ownership comes from the server.

tweet.texto: Fight for your flag. PillWars country skins are here: pick yours in the Skin Store with points you earn playing. 🇨🇦🇪🇸🇫🇷 #pixelart #gamedev

entregables.titulo: Mobile web version
entregables.incluye: PillWars playable in a phone browser: the game turned to landscape, a mode selector as a wheel, the mode menu, HUD and every poster adapted, a quick colour palette, the name asked just before playing and the landing laid out for mobile.
entregables.hechoCuando: A full match can be played from a phone browser.
entregables.verificacion: Tuned on a phone: HUD bugs, posters and the one-frame flash of the rotated screens fixed one by one.

tweet.texto: PillWars now runs in your phone's browser. Same arena, same skills, built for your thumbs. 📱 #gamedev #mobilegaming

entregables.titulo: Gameplay polish: compass, crowns and kill rewards
entregables.incluye: An ENEMIES compass that points to the crowd after 5 s without seeing anyone, a 3-ring radar, podium crowns in arcade with a rank indicator and its sounds, new effects for teleport and gaining or losing mass, the kill reward shown in dollars, offline classic with 40 bots that you can actually win, shots that no longer feed rivals, and a 3-2-1 countdown in the title font.
entregables.hechoCuando: Matches always lead you to someone to fight and every kill shows what you earned.
entregables.verificacion: Played offline and online in both modes.

entregables.incluye: The Genesis Drop page: sign in with X and connect (or paste) a wallet, a points card to share on X, social quests, one-time quests with a ×1.5 boost, invites, on-chain points (wallet age, Airdrop Hunter, Saga/Seeker Genesis Token, Mad Lads, Jumper) and a real LEADERBOARD. entregables.incluye: A Discord with verify and ticket buttons, an AutoMod against scams and an #x-feed channel, and a Telegram bot that pins every announcement, forwards our X posts, answers common questions and runs raids (/raid, /raidtop). Support by DM through the bot, with an Inbox in the admin panel installable as a phone app.

entregables.incluye: An Android app for Solana Mobile (Saga and Seeker) for the dApp Store: landscape, BUILT ON SOLANA loading screen and TAP TO START, a joystick bottom-left with skills in circles next to SPLIT, sign-in with X or with the phone's wallet (Seed Vault via MWA), PROFILE with avatar, and an offline mode thanks to a service worker. entregables.titulo: Team arenas, friends and arena prizes
entregables.incluye: ARENAS 1v1 / 2v2 / 3v3: QUICK MATCH, FIND RIVALS and custom rooms with a code, groups with READY, practice against bots while you wait, a VS screen with photos and each team's money, VICTORY / DEFEAT with their sounds, REJOIN and a hunting arrow. entregables.titulo: New hub menu
entregables.incluye: A new menu for PC and mobile: bars for THE PILL, ARENAS, FRIENDS, STORE, QUESTS and PILLWARS CORE (guides and videos: ORIGIN, HOW TO PLAY, basics, skills), panels that slide in, a top bar with avatar and XP, a SYSTEM plate with a queue of notices (whispers, friend requests, group invites), ROOMS with layers, ROOM INFO and RULES, and every notice with the same grey frame.
entregables.hechoCuando: Everything in the game is reachable from the hub on PC and mobile.
entregables.verificacion: Checked on wide and narrow windows and on the app.

tweet.texto: New PillWars menu: your pill, arenas, friends, store, quests and video guides, all one click away. #gamedev #UI #indiedev

entregables.titulo: Living round map and the new arcade
entregables.incluye: Round maps in every mode that grow and shrink with the number of players. Classic gets skills (no fixed SHOOT), 15 s of entry protection and an end screen like the arenas (PENTAKILL, QUADRA, DEFEAT, CASHOUT). The new arcade: 3 fixed minutes, a safe zone that closes in phases, events like TAX ON THE TOP, crowns worth extra mass and prizes by player count. SHOOT and CLONE aim with a first tap and fire with the second.
entregables.hechoCuando: A full arcade match closes the zone and pays by placement.
entregables.verificacion: Tuned online and offline, with the offline end screen shown only once per match.

tweet.texto: The PillWars arena is alive: the map grows and shrinks with players, and arcade now has a closing safe zone, 3-minute matches and nasty events like TAX ON THE TOP. #gamedev #battleroyale

entregables.titulo: Mainnet for custody and staking
entregables.incluye: Move the custody and staking contracts from devnet to mainnet: calibration with real data, multisig authority, the checklist of DESPLIEGUE-TESORERIA.md all green and the legal decision on paid rooms first.
entregables.hechoCuando: Both programs are initialised on mainnet and the auditor passes against them.

entregables.titulo: Client-side prediction
entregables.incluye: Predict your own movement on the client and reconcile it with the server, so the pill responds instantly even with ping.
entregables.hechoCuando: With 150 ms of ping the pill reacts with no visible delay or rubber-banding.

entregables.titulo: Real monitoring
entregables.incluye: Grafana/Prometheus instead of the home-made stress test to watch ticks, bytes and players in production.
entregables.hechoCuando: Production metrics are on a dashboard with alerts.

entregables.titulo: Shared state in Redis
entregables.incluye: Sessions and matchmaking shared between processes through Redis.
entregables.hechoCuando: Director and Hosts share sessions without IPC.

entregables.titulo: Anti-bot heuristics
entregables.incluye: The server accepts inputs from any WebSocket and can't tell a human from a script; heuristics to spot bots and aimbots.
entregables.hechoCuando: A scripted client is flagged in a test match.

entregables.titulo: WATCH videos and new gameplay clips
entregables.incluye: Upload the WATCH videos and record presentable clips of SPLIT, VIRUS, COMBAT and each skill (the automatic recording isn't good enough yet), plus the GAME MODES video.
entregables.hechoCuando: Every WATCH entry and skill INFO plays its own clip.
